oracle: strict branch-and-bound max-weight schedulable subset; returns a valid lower bound on the optimum, proven-optimal on tight cases

verdict.matching_value_density: well-posed and reachable in principle (ceiling > VD > RL), not yet achieved; needs training changes (VD warm-start + longer + multi-seed), not router tuning
verdict.beating_value_density: near-impossible in the current near-separable synthetic env (~1-3% headroom, concentrated in tight-closure cases)
verdict.honest_target: match value_density within CI; RL value proposition is the continuous-preference interface + safety gate + single-checkpoint Pareto set, not utility superiority
verdict.hard_boundary: RL's advantage over greedy needs a non-myopic environment (real berth/service times via ServiceTimeSource, not yet available)

limitations: Oracle is a lower bound except on the ~30% proven cases; the true ceiling is equal or slightly higher, which only strengthens the near-optimality of value_density.
Single seed, synthetic weather/resources, fixed 30-vessel observation contract.
